title: Three Days and One Short Map
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：location　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 location 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the guide ① chose the location that no traveller in the coast would have described, and he said the choosing was the whole of the day. The ② location, meaning the place itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; a location, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ location in that coast had the same short map beside it, and the ④ location at the far cove, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A location, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the guide said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the location was the whole of the matter, meaning the bearing and not the place. The ⑥ location, meaning the bearing and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; location, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a place and a bearing. He said the bearing is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ location had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ location of the whole thing, the guide wrote in June, was one coast and three days of describing; location, he said, is either the mark at the far cove or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ location I remember is the place described in the guidebook, which closed in 1996 and is still described as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ location, my mother said in 1998, is the only place that improves by being described; every location, she said, is a bearing that has agreed to look like a place. She said the bearing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地点；位置（指海岸里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 地点；位置（指那处地点本身，与地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the location 选定这个地点
D. n. 地点；位置（指留给孩子们找的那一处那一处）
E. n. 选址之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的地点之事）
F. n. 地点；位置（指旅行手册里写到、被记述的的那一处）
G. n. 方位、所在（指一件事里人人都找却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 所在（抽象总称，指人人都找却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the location that no traveller in the coast would have described
The location, meaning the place itself and not the map
the location at the far cove
the location was the whole of the matter
the location had become a line in a guidebook
The location of the whole thing
A location, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: choose the location 意为“选定这个地点”，1989 年那位向导把海岸里没有一位旅人肯记述的一个地点做了一遍。
location 意为“地点；位置”，指那处地点本身而不是地图，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记述。
location 意为“地点；位置”，指海岸里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一张小小的地图。
location 意为“地点；位置”，指最远那处小湾留给孩子们找的那一处那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
location 意为“方位、所在”，指一件事里人人都找却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个方位就是那件事的全部。
location 意为“所在”，指人人都找却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处地点，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
location 意为“地点；位置”，指旅行手册里写到、被记述的的那一处，到 1994 年这一处成了旅行手册里的一行。
location 意为“选址之事”，向导六月写道，整件事的地点之事是一处海岸和三个日子的记述。
location 意为“地点；位置”，我记得的是旅行手册里记述过的那一处，1996 年定下了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一处。
location 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，地点是唯一会因为被好好记述而变得更好的地点。
